title: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
seoTitle: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Fast skillet pasta with parsley, capers, and peeled shrimp
subtitle: Fast skillet pasta with parsley, capers, and peeled shrimp
description: Large shrimp sauté with garlic and red pepper flakes, then tossed with whole-wheat linguine, lemon, capers, and parsley. Built for two large skillets on the station range.

steps.title: Boil pasta in salted water
steps.instruction: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil with 2 tbsp salt. Cook linguine 9–11 minutes until al dente with a slight firm bite at the center.

steps.title: Sear shrimp quickly
steps.instruction: Heat olive oil in two large skillets over medium-high. Sear shrimp 1–2 minutes per side until pink and curled, not rubbery. Work in batches.

steps.title: Build lemon garlic sauce
steps.instruction: Reduce heat to medium. Add butter and garlic to skillets; cook 45 seconds until fragrant. Add lemon zest, juice, capers, and pepper flakes.

steps.title: Toss pasta with shrimp
steps.instruction: Add drained pasta with 1 cup pasta water. Toss 2–3 minutes until sauce emulsifies and coats noodles with a silky gloss, not a pool of oil.

steps.title: Finish with parsley and serve
steps.instruction: Fold in parsley off heat. Shrimp should be opaque throughout; pasta should slide on the plate without clumping.

proTips: Pat shrimp bone-dry before searing—wet shrimp steam instead of caramelize.
Reserve extra pasta water; whole-wheat pasta absorbs more liquid than white.
Serve immediately—this dish does not hold well on a steam table.
tonightSpread: Simple mixed green salad with balsamic vinaigrette.
Garlic bread made from split baguette under the broiler.
leftovers: Reheat gently with splash of water; avoid microwave on high or shrimp turn rubbery.
Chill leftovers into a next-day pasta salad with cherry tomatoes.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Feels indulgent but stays lean. Comes together fast when the crew is hungry and the clock is short.
mealPrepNotes: Peel and devein shrimp ahead; keep on ice. Pre-measure pasta water salt and lemon juice in squeeze bottles. Station: Boil pasta in the biggest pot available—crowded pasta water returns to boil slowly. Station: Finish shrimp in two skillets so they sear rather than stew in their own liquid. Station: Toss pasta off heat so shrimp stay tender and garlic does not scorch.
